title: File:Saint George the Victorious Gold Coin, Rostov-on-Don, Russia.jpg
desc: The Russian George the Victorious coins are coins issued in gold and silver by the Central Bank of Russia. The gold coin has a face value of 50 rubles. It has denomination of "50 rubles" minted in 99.9% purity, and contains not less than 7.78 grams of fine pure gold. Rostov-on-Don, Russia.

title: File:Gold coin of Diodotus, Indo-Greek, National Museum, New Delhi.jpg
desc: Gold coin of Diodotus, Indo-Greek, National Museum, New Delhi.Diodotus I Soter, was the first Hellenistic king of Bactria. Diodotus became independent of the Seleucid empire around 255 BCE, and established the Greco-Bactrian Kingdom.
